content.name: Dog Riding Roller Coaster
content.description: An image of a dog riding a roller coaster with its front paws raised. The image is commonly shared online as a humorous reaction image representing excitement, embracing chaos, or simply going along for the ride.

scene_context: A humorous reaction image depicting a dog enjoying a roller coaster. It is often used to convey feelings of excitement, chaos, or accepting an unpredictable situation.

meme.meaning: Represents being caught up in an exciting, chaotic, or unexpected situation while simply enjoying or enduring the ride.
meme.how_a_caption_should_use_it: Captions usually describe a situation where someone unexpectedly finds themselves committed to a rapidly unfolding or chaotic experience, with the image serving as the reaction. Examples: 'Me after agreeing to plans without asking for details.' 'When production deploys on Friday and there's no rollback.' 'My brain during finals week.'
meme.image_delivers: being along for the ride despite uncertainty or chaos
